decisive_spans.text: CT Scan Results: Edematous thickening of the intestinal wall in the ascending colon with peripheral exudative changes
Follow-up CT: Distension of anterior wall of ascending colon with gas, exudation in subserosa of middle section, and small quantity of ascites

response.rationale: Typhlitis is strongly supported by the CT findings of edematous thickening of the intestinal wall in the ascending colon and peripheral exudative changes, as well as distension of the anterior wall of the ascending colon with gas, exudation, and ascites. Neutropenic colitis is also supported by the patient's history of leukocytopenia and the presence of abdominal pain and inflammation, but the specific CT findings point more directly to typhlitis. The other candidates are either contradicted or less strongly supported by the provided information.
